Never buy these chocolate brands again.  Kinder, Kit Kat, Lindt, Snickers, M&Ms, Hersheys and Cadbury All of the chocolate brands I just showed you have one thing in common. They are all starting to use lab-grown chocolate.  They are spending billions of dollars into biotech startups that are making the switch from real cocoa to lab-grown.  It's made by extracting cacao cells, multiplying them in massive steel bioreactors, and then processing it into fake chocolate. To avoid this, look out for terms like cell-cultured, cell-based, or cell-cultivated cocoa. And read the caption for the healthiest chocolate brands
